comparator.name: Academische lerarenopleiding primair onderwijs
comparator.institution: Utrecht University / HU University of Applied Sciences Utrecht
comparator.sourceNotes: The normalized record describes a 180-EC Utrecht University variant, but the current official ALPO pages define a joint four-year programme delivered by Utrecht University and HU University of Applied Sciences Utrecht. It awards both the HU primary-teacher-education diploma and the Utrecht University bachelor's degree in Educational Sciences. The official curriculum runs through four explicit years, starts school placement and workplace research in year one, assigns 25% of the programme to practice, and culminates in a thesis and graduation teaching placement in year four. Dutch government guidance establishes a 60-EC annual study load and 240 EC for a four-year higher-professional bachelor. The supported year components are therefore recorded at 60 EC each, totaling 240 EC. That current official programme identity and load cannot be reconciled with the normalized 180-EC single-institution target without first resolving whether the registry row is intended to represent only the embedded Utrecht University Educational Sciences credential or the complete joint ALPO pathway.

components.name: Year 1: primary-teaching foundations, educational sciences, classroom research and school placement
components.note: The official curriculum describes subject teaching in language and mathematics, child learning and development, introductory educational research, lesson design and school placement from the start of the programme.

components.name: Year 2: subject didactics, educational psychology, research methods and school placement
components.note: The official curriculum develops literacy and subject didactics, educational psychology, observation, interviewing, questionnaires and research conducted in the placement school.

components.name: Year 3: learner differences, inclusive education, advanced research and school placement
components.note: The official curriculum addresses cognitive and social differences, learning and behavioural difficulties, special educational needs, educational research and continued professional practice.

components.name: Year 4: school organisation, bachelor thesis and graduation teaching placement
components.note: The official curriculum culminates in organisational and professional study, thesis research and a graduation placement used to assess readiness for primary-school teaching.

exception.reason: The normalized target is a 180-EC Utrecht University variant, while the current official programme with the same ALPO name is an integrated four-year Utrecht University/HU pathway leading to two diplomas and carrying a supported 240-EC workload. A counselor comparison cannot silently discard the fourth year, the HU teacher-qualification curriculum, the bachelor thesis or the graduation teaching placement, nor can it treat the complete joint pathway as a conventional 180-EC university bachelor. The target identity and study load must be corrected or explicitly scoped before a defensible UCR comparison can be produced.
exception.curriculumContext: The supported 240-EC current pathway combines primary-school subject knowledge and didactics, educational and developmental science, research methods, classroom-based inquiry and continuous school practice. School placement begins in year one, practice accounts for 25% of the programme, and the fourth year includes school-organisation study, thesis research and the final teaching placement. No UCR alternative is constructed because the blocking issue is the normalized programme identity and load, not a concluded judgment about UCR course fit.
